data.summary: Reviews show significant authenticity concerns. While many positive Google reviews are detailed, the stark contrast with Yelp's 2.1 rating and the pattern of serious, specific complaints about delays, unapproved construction, and refusal to address issues post-payment are major red flags. The repeated 'third pool build' phrasing in positive reviews and Yelp snippet repetition suggest possible review manipulation.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star Google reviews mention 'third pool build' with similar phrasing
Yelp search results show the same positive snippet repeated across multiple unrelated listings, suggesting potential manipulation
Positive Google reviews are detailed but follow a similar template of praising specific staff

negative_evidence: Refused to honor word/engineer report (jerry myers review)
Poor craftsmanship not addressed (Richard Evanson review)
positive_evidence: Mason helped after project completion (Chris Estes review)

authentic_signals: Specific names and roles mentioned (Mason, Nick, Bryce, Tyler, Chris, Allen, Stacia, Tom, Jay)
Detailed project timelines and processes described
Negative reviews provide specific, credible complaints with dates and interactions
Varied writing styles and perspectives across reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google (4.4) and Yelp (2.1) ratings. Google reviews are overwhelmingly positive, while Yelp shows a very low rating, suggesting potential review manipulation or different customer segments.

reviews.text: We highly recommend Mirage Pools. This was our 3rd custom pool and from start to finish the experience was incredible. Our team of Nick, Mason and  Bryce delivered every single day. Mason was exceptional at calling and letting us know what was coming next, when crews would arrive and what was left to be completed. From first meeting to water in the pool was less than 3 months. The quality was exceptional and they were extremely responsive to questions and even suggested changes along the way. I don’t plan on moving again, but I would call them again.
reviews.author: Damita Williams

reviews.text:
This was my third pool build, and Mirage Custom Pools was by far the best company I have worked with. From our very first meeting, their team truly listened to what I wanted and offered thoughtful feedback and suggestions without ever feeling pushy. They were respectful of our budget while still finding ways to incorporate every feature we hoped to include in the design.

The build process was incredibly efficient without sacrificing quality. Aside from a few brief pauses for inspections, there was consistent progress with crews working almost every day. Even more impressive, Mirage Pools continued to follow through on every item on the punch list—down to the smallest detail—well after final payment was made.

Throughout the entire process, they were responsive, helpful, and proactive in addressing any questions or concerns. Their professionalism and commitment to excellence truly set them apart. I would highly recommend Mirage Custom Pools to anyone looking to build a pool or enhance their backyard space.
reviews.author: Stacee Siegele

reviews.text: We are absolutely thrilled with our second pool built by Mirage Custom Pools! Being a repeat customer is the highest praise we can offer, and once again, they exceeded expectations. The entire construction process was a great experience, especially due to the outstanding work of Mason, the construction team leader. He was exceptional at keeping us informed every step of the way and promptly and professionally addressed any concern that arose. The quality of the final product is stunning. If you want a smooth, stress-free pool build, look no further!
reviews.author: Obinna Egonu

reviews.text:
Had a great experience with Mirage. Initially we worked with Tyler who did the best job of all the companies we spoke with in coming up with a really nice and unique design.

Mason, our project manager was outstanding to work with. Communication throughout the project was great and the entire project was done in around 2 and a half months (They even worked around some of our existing landscape without causing damage). Even after the completion of the project, Mason has been good about helping with small items/questions that pop up.

Have been dealing with Julie recently with a couple of minor warranty issues and she has been very friendly, responsive, and easy to work with so far as well.

If we were to go back through the pool selection and building process, we would go with Mirage again.
reviews.author: Chris Estes

reviews.text: Highly Recommend this company. From the start of the process, Chris was so helpful and patient as we navigated through figuring out what exactly we wanted. He took our vision and put the rendering together. From the start of the pool building process, Mason was spot on. The crews used throughout the entire process were so professional and clean. Thank you, Mirage Custom Pool for an amazing pool and spa. You guys knocked it out of the park!!
reviews.author: Billye England

reviews.text: We just finished our pool in April. Mirage was amazing. First, Tyler was a great consultant to work with.  We had a price in mind and he kept us there through the whole process. Mason was our project manager and did a fantastic job. We went from breaking ground to water in pool in less than 90 days. It even froze 2 days after the dig. All of the crew members were exceptional. I'm still deciding on what I want on the columns. I'm thinking fire bowls. Great job. My family loves our new backyard.
reviews.author: Jeff Nichols

reviews.text: We recently moved to Texas and wanted a pool for our new home.  We found a house in Prosper that had the most amazing pool, however, we were outbid.  When we finally found our home although there wasn’t a pool I asked my realtor who built the pool at the house we did not get. It was Mirage Custom pools and I knew I needed to go with them.  I did my due diligence and got 4 companies to design and quote for a pool and spa. Mirage did not only have the best design, they were also the best price.  We broke ground mid July and 3 months to the day was complete! Mason our project manager was fantastic - kept the project ahead of schedule and communicated every step of the way.  My backyard went from a bunch of weeds to looking like a resort. We still have to do the landscaping but the transformation has made this our dream backyard.
reviews.author: Chris Guzlas

reviews.text: I looked around and asked a number of friends for referrals before choosing a pool company and ultimately went with Mirage after getting a total of three quotes.  They were very helpful and patient throughout the design process and picking of tiles, colors, features, etc. as this was our first time to ever build a pool.  When doing a project of this size and scope, you are always going to have issues that come up but the sign of a good company is how they handle them.  Stacia truly does an amazing job as she was so responsive and helpful whenever I reached out to her.  No matter the question or need, Stacia is a superstar in how she supports her customers and in how she represents Mirage.  I also appreciated that Tom (Mirage owner) also came out to meet with me and to assist as needed to make sure we were completely happy with our end result.  I am very happy with the quality of the materials, workmanship and equipment and have no doubt my family and I will be enjoying our new pool for years to come.  A special thanks again to Stacia for the great job she did in taking care of us!
reviews.author: Richard Mathews

reviews.text: Mirage Custom Pools did an awesome job on our design of our pool.  The staff that assisted us from the beginning of the process to the completion of the pool were top notch and professional.   Our project manager Allen,  was top notch!  He keep us informed with every step of the build and when issues arose, he got them resolved fast.   I would highly recommend Mirage Custom Pools if you are thinking about getting a pool put in.   Thank you Allen and Stacia!!
reviews.author: Michael Chambers

reviews.text: Had a great experience building our pool with Mirage. Our designer, Jay, was wonderful to work with and did such a great design. He exceeded what we could have imagined. Also, he took the time to listen to our needs, wants and requests and then put them all in action with his design. Also Tom was great to help us through the build when questions came up. I would recommend them both and Mirage Pools to any friends looking to build a pool.
reviews.author: Angela Cryer

reviews.text: Landed upon Mirage by chance but I am so glad I did. From the beginning, this was truly a transparent and professional build. Mason and Bryce took over the project once it had been sold and they did not miss a beat. From day 1, Mason made sure everything was moving as it should and made sure to address any questions or concerns that I had. I'm really glad I went with Mirage as we were truly satisfied with the entire team and their professionalism and honesty!
reviews.author: N A

reviews.text: We just finished building a pool with Mirage. Overall we are very happy with the experience. Mason our project manager did a great job of communicating throughout the project and being onsite to answer any questions.
reviews.author: Ron Ervin

reviews.text:
We couldn’t be happier with my experience working with Mirage Custom Pools! From the very first consultation with Jeff to the final touches, everything was handled with professionalism, care, and a true passion for excellence. Jeff took the time to really understand my vision and helped guide me toward the perfect design for our backyard.

Mason, our project manager, was incredible throughout the entire process. He kept us updated every step of the way, answered all our questions with patience, and made sure everything ran smoothly and on schedule. His attention to detail and commitment to quality were evident in every phase of the build.

The final result blew us away—our new pool is absolutely stunning and has completely transformed our backyard. It’s not just a pool; it’s a personal retreat, and we owe it all to the amazing team at Mirage Custom Pools. We’re beyond grateful and would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a top-notch pool builder!!!!
reviews.author: Doris S

reviews.text: Quality work.  Had an outdoor kitchen built along with pool.  Everything is great.  They took the time to teach me the pool equipment part.  I did have an issue with our Quartzscape Barbados Blue finish.  Mirage resolved this quickly though and the color and look of my pool is exactly what I was looking for.  They stood behind their work.  Excellent.  I recommend Mirage to other people and neighbors.  They have built several in my subdivision.
reviews.author: Lardo 5150

reviews.text:
This was our first pool. We had a lot of questions. Tyler was instrumental in answering a lot of upfront questions. The design process was super easy and gave us confidence. Ultimately it was the PM, Mason, that gave us the final comfort to sign answering tons of questions on the project.

Then we started. Mason likely got tired of our questions but he never showed it. He really exceeded our expectations on the pool and where the project shifted he problem solved and came with a solution.

Ultimately it’s been a good experience and we would recommend.
reviews.author: Brian Skelton

reviews.text: Mirage, thank you for creating our backyard dream oasis. Although the project started out rocky, Peter, Tom and Bryce was able to make things right. I really appreciate the follow through, the great communication and most of all an amazing job. The project took longer due to COVID-19, but the end product was worth the wait.
reviews.author: Diane Jackson

reviews.text: It’s coming up on one year since our pool was built, very happy with my pool and hot tub. Thank you for all the follow up on service from Mason and his team. Thank you very much for a great back yard..
reviews.author: Sheryl Giles

reviews.text: Using Mirrage to build my pool was the single worst financial decision of my entire life! Poor craftsmanship, terrible communication, manipulative, deceitful, untrustworthy. Took 17 months to build our pool and it’s still not right. Not worth going with this horrific company just to save some money.
reviews.author: Richard Evanson

reviews.text:
First, we asked Mirage to work in collaboration with our Landscape Architect in the design of our pool and backyard landscape.  Mirage, who claimed to know our HOA, and our Landscape Architect presented our plan to the HOA and it was not approved. We developed a revised plan that Mirage and our Landscape Architect presented and it was approved.  BUT, MIRAGE BUILT THE FIRST, UNAPPROVED PLAN.

Second, we submitted a picture of a pergola that we wanted built, which they agreed to build, but was different from the one Mirage usually builds for clients.  They BUILT THE WRONG PERGOLA!

Third, they a) did built our pool in conditions that allowed it to fail 27 days after it was filled, and b) did not fulfill the recommendations of the engineer (that they recommended) for ensuring a stable pool.

They refused to fix the issues that allowed the pool to fail, which created ongoing problems with the decking tiles, caused the pool water-line tiles to fall off, and caused the coping tiles to lift and become uneven.

The pictures are taken right after the pool was filled and through the 1st year.  We have 60 more.
reviews.author: Patti Hansen

reviews.text:
From day 1 very impressed with the mirage team.  Jeff one of the owners was our designer, he met with us on zoom several times to design a pool he wanted us to be happy with.  He was also very detailed about the engineering, pipe locations and layouts, etc… I also feel like he installed the best pool management equipment as well.  His motto was I want your pool to be as good or better than mine.  When it came time to build the pool Mason their project manager was meticulous at making sure that everything was done right.  Mason was by almost every day to make sure steps were on schedule and bing done right.  Jeff even came by to QC the build and had recommended modifications to some of the design to make it look that much better.  Tom their finance manager was also easy to
Work with.  Even better they partner with great subcontractors. Post build and they stand by their word and product.  Being a new pool owner and new to Texas leaving a pool open all winter had me concerned.  You call mason and he’s always around to help with advise and just make sure you get the assistance you need. Pay attention to “pool school” it’s important. I would hire Mirage again and highly recommend them.  There’s good reason why they have an A+ rating.
reviews.author: John Gerken

reviews.text: My wife and I were worried about the outcome the 'dream pool' that we had contracted and whether or not it would complement our beautiful home. The process was lengthy and challenging but ultimately Mirage Pool built us our dream pool that beautifully complements our home. Jeff Hauk designed our pool and patiently listened to our wants and needs. I am grateful that the 'plan' ended up exactly as we dreamed of in our back yard. I want to specifically complement Jason Lampe, the site construction supervisor, who patiently managed the entire project through the 'covid' mess and the 'winter to end all winters'. Jason is a hard working man who told me truth even though I didn't want to necessarily hear it. I have held off on writing this review until the two remaining punch list items were taken care of. We are extremely happy with the outcome of the pool despite some challenging moments. Thank you Jason (and Jeff) for the beautiful pool.
reviews.author: DJ Alex

reviews.text:
My family and I couldn’t be happier with our new Mirage Custom Pool! From start to finish, the entire process was seamless, thanks to the professionalism and expertise of Jeff and Mason. The design phase was very easy and they were flexible with all of our feedback, changes, and ideas. They truly listened to our vision and also provided suggestions that made the pool even better than we imagined.

The construction team was punctual, hardworking, and respectful of our property. Mason kept us informed every step of the way, and the project was completed fairly quickly. Any thoughts we had and or questions have and were answered, even post build. As Mason said, we won't leave you hanging.

The finished product is absolutely stunning. The craftsmanship and attention to detail are evident in every inch of the pool. They installed turf throughout the yard and it looks great! Our backyard has been transformed and I know my family and in particular our sons will have years of fun and enjoyment!

We highly recommend Mirage Custom Pools to anyone considering a pool build. Their combination of expertise, and customer care is unmatched!
reviews.author: Gilbert Holguin

reviews.text: I purchased a home in late 2024 and wasn't able to move in until late spring 2025 due to health issues - perfect time to add a pool (exercise need) during late winter.  Owner Jeff met with me several times to discuss concepts, costs and design elements.  Permitting timing went smoothly as he anticipated with just minor miscommunication on the part of the city.  My Project Mgr was Mason (professional, knowledgable, extremely responsive and friendly) - either he or Jeff or both were there each step of the project to oversee the different phases.  Tyler also played a role in details with settings and sweep.  Once the pool was wrapping up, I needed to finish out a mudhole of a backyard.  Based on the positive experience I had with Mirage, Mason, Jeff and Tyler, I did a phase II for the yard/landscape.  They helped me cut costs where we could, showed up when they were scheduled and are wrapping up minor details as I write this review.  The pool and yard are beautiful and based on the other quotes I received, I feel I made the best choice.  Mirage is a smaller company and yes, they use vetted contractors.  Those contractors (fence/sod/spinkler, etc) were professional, prompt, friendly, helpful and gracious.  I always felt safe with them on my property. I felt I could trust the timeline and process outlined by Jeff and managed by Mason every step of the way.  Due to circumstances, I'm not  in the position to manage a project like this - the Mirage team was the bomb.
reviews.author: Kathryn Gloria (Kat)

reviews.text: My 3rd pool with Mirage and I would do it again.  Talk about consistency, Mirage proactively communicates, Mason sets the bar high in supervising the process from end to end.  Could not be more grateful for his transparency and keeping things on schedule.  Thank you to Mason, Jeff and Tom for an amazing product our family will enjoy for decades to come.
reviews.author: Scott Bahr

reviews.text:
We had a great experience working with Mirage. During the design process, Jeff worked with us on a great design staying conscious of our budget and how to best utilize our space.

Mason, our project manager, had great communication throughout the process and was frequently present onsite through construction ensuring everything was done correctly and to plan. The pool was completed quickly and we were more than satisfied with the work performed.

After our project completed, the team has remained responsive to any questions we've had. If we were building another pool, we would go with Mirage again.
reviews.author: J E

reviews.text: We got our pool done about a year ago, and the post-delivery service has been great since then. Mason, our construction manager, is always quick to respond and really helpful anytime we have a question. Tom from Mirage Pools has been just as easy to reach and supportive throughout.
reviews.author: SK

reviews.text:
Quick update.  Was told the by owner Tom to have an engineer come out and write report to see if there was any wrongdoing and if there was they’d take care of it.  Once we did that and paid the engineer he back pedaled and said he never said that.  The report was sent to them and now they’re stating “speculation “.

We will get the pool fixed but stay as far away from this company as you possibly can.  They don’t honor their word for anything and after you pay them they basically throw you aside like trash. My wife and I are a young couple so I’m guessing we’re being looked at as being young and dumb.  Again STAY AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY !!!!

And they honestly had the audacity to ask me to remove this review.. what a joke.

reviews.text: After interviewing a handful of companies, including sister company, Hauk Custom Pools, we ultimately decided to have Mirage build us our first pool. While the pricing was slightly higher than other options, we felt comfortable with their sales team and were confident that the quality would live up to their promises. We started our journey with Mirage in late 2019 and communication and attention to detail was excellent during the initial design and material selection phase. As expected, construction started on our pool in April 2020. The second they dug the hole, everything went downhill. Our construction manager was at our site a grand total of 5 times during the entire construction and would not return phone calls or messages. We would go weeks without any progress and no explanation or communication. We had to work directly with the sub-contractors and we were fortunately working from home, as we caught several mistakes early. The quality from their subcontractors was quite good and met our expectations. As we approached the time to plaster our pool, we had a punchlist of about 20 items (some major, some minor) that needed to be completed prior to plaster, yet Mirage chose to move forward anyway. At the time, despite wanting to finish out the punchlist, we were happy to have our pool filled in August 2020, and had the expectation that our punchlist would be quickly addressed.... Fast forward to today, September 2021.....13 months after our pool was 'finished'. We still have over a dozen items on our punchlist. We have had 3 additional project managers come to us with promises that they would help us, yet no progress. We have tried multiple times to reach out to the owner, and never received a response. See attached pictures for examples of our punchlist (cracked tiles, major gouges in grotto slab, flooded sunken firepit). I would strongly encourage you to avoid using Mirage, and if you do, insist on setting up the contract to protect yourself. Insist on interviewing the PM's. There has been a lot of turnover in their organization due to poor performance, so I would assume their new PM's are quite inexperienced. If we were to do it over again, we would have used another company.
reviews.author: David Dyer
